name: Card Swap
description: Perspective stack of cards where the front card flies out and the rest move forward, with autoplay, drag and click to swap, spring physics, pointer parallax and light or dark themes.
contents: Stack of cards in 3D perspective, each with icon badge, title and image (4 sample cards by default)
Exported Card component for building custom card content as children
Ref API with next() and prev()
behavior: Autoplay cycles the front card out and back to the rear at a set delay
Spring-based motion with bounce, pointer parallax and hover spread of the stack
Drag, click or arrow keys swap cards (arrows go next and previous)
Pauses on hover, when off screen or when the tab is hidden
Intro animation on mount, honors prefers-reduced-motion
Cards behind the front are dimmed and fade out past the visible count
editableByProps: Card content through items or custom children
Card size, spacing, depth, skew, visible count and corner radius
Autoplay, delay, hover pause, dragging, speed, bounce, parallax, hover spread and dimming
Dark or light theme and intro animation

needsCodeEdit.change: Change theme colors or add a new theme
Change card layout (title row, image area)

needsCodeEdit.where: PERSPECTIVE constant and perspective in STAGE_STYLE

fixed: Requires @hugeicons/react and @hugeicons/core-free-icons for the default sample icons
Sample images load from Unsplash URLs
New cards always enter from below
Sets aria-label 'Card stack' and a carousel role, root is keyboard focusable
Listens to document visibilitychange to pause when the tab is hidden
Scales down to fit its container width
